title: Order total is one cent too low with discount code SAVE15
author: qa-mirela
body:
While testing discount codes I got $16.95 for order #6850 (one Gel pen at $19.95 with SAVE15). By our money standard it should be $16.96: 19.95 x 0.85 = 16.9575, rounded half up.

I added a test that reproduces it (`test_discount_rounds_half_up`); it fails in CI run 4412. The existing discount tests all pass, which worries me more than the bug itself.

Please find the cause, tell me why the existing tests did not catch it, and propose the regression tests we need.
